title: 15 Get Rich Quick Schemes and Why They Fail
description:
Americans reported losing $12.5 billion to fraud in a single year, and investment scams were the biggest category. In this video I go through 15 get rich quick schemes from three angles: the classics and the math that dooms them (Ponzi, MLMs, lottery, day trading), the hype schemes (pump and dumps, trading gurus, seminars) and the internet-age scams (pig butchering, AI trading bots), plus a 10 red flag checklist.

- Growth figures: stated illustrative math
